dedupe_keys.name: econ powerci european electricity consumption and carbon intensity

description: The ECON-PowerCI team publishes a daily European table of electricity consumption and grid carbon intensity. The Zenodo release contains one CSV named for 2015 through 2024 and is free under CC BY 4.0. The describing article presents the series as a near-real-time analysis resource, but this archived file's dates should be checked before assuming that it updates continuously. The observations can calibrate aggregate electricity demand and emissions assumptions in European power-system simulations, with model-pypsa-eur a related modelling context. A caveat is that country carbon intensity depends on generation accounting, imports and the underlying reporting sources, while daily aggregation hides hourly scarcity and congestion. National series should not be treated as feeder-level loads. Own metadata and the file manifest were checked without downloading values. A separate notebook that generates or analyzes the series is assessed as software.
